baseline_models.mechanism: Favor initiates a continuity mechanism: descendants disperse, a remnant is carried, guidance routes it, and selection gathers it. The named people are nodes in preserved transmission rather than a prestige roster.

activation_trace.role: Good condition and bestowed benefit supply the initiating favor.
Minute dispersal supplies the spreading plurality of descendants.
Visible carriage supplies preservation by transport through rupture.
Gentle direction supplies a route for the preserved line.
Gathering and acquisition close dispersal into a selected cohort.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists honored ancestors and prophets.
changed_reading.after: The verse maps a continuity system in which favor preserves, routes, and regathers human transmission across dispersed descent and the carried remnant.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إذا تتلى عليهم آيات الرحمن خروا سجدا وبكيا
baseline_models.mechanism: Recitation unfolds as following and sequence; the signs arrive as manifest markers, and the hearers answer with a noisy fall, lowered posture, and tears. Meaning travels through the whole body rather than stopping at comprehension.

activation_trace.role: Following and succession make recitation the first motion in a response sequence.
The visible sign supplies what is recognized in the recited material.
A disturbed, sounding fall converts recognition into sudden bodily descent.
Lowering and submission give the fall its directed posture.
Grief, tears, and voice make inward reception externally audible.

changed_reading.before: The prophets choose to respond piously after hearing revelation.
changed_reading.after: Recited signs set off a sequential, embodied cascade in which recognition becomes descent, submission, tears, and sound.

baseline_models.mechanism: The kinship and womb branches of mercy occur inside a verse saturated with descendants and carrying. The Merciful therefore overlays biological descent with a life-bearing relation, making tears a recognition of sustaining belonging as well as emotion.

activation_trace.role: Dispersed small life supplies the many-branched descendant field.
Inner carrying and fruit supply a gestational image alongside Noahic transport.
Kinship gives mercy a relational bond spanning the named lines.
The womb supplies the life-bearing enclosure beneath the genealogy.
Tears register embodied recognition of that sustaining relation.

changed_reading.before: Al-Rahman is an epithet identifying the giver of the signs.
changed_reading.after: Al-Rahman's signs address a transgenerational family held by a mercy imaged as kinship and life-bearing enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The father's objects are defined by failed hearing and sight, while the focus group receives recited signs and visibly collapses. The response functions as evidence of living receptivity, not decorative emotion.

activation_trace.role: Auditory perception is explicitly absent from the worshiped object, supplying the negative pole.
Visual perception is likewise denied, completing the nonresponsive contrast.
Successive recitation supplies the signal that the living recipients can receive.
Their sounding fall makes reception externally verifiable.

structural_cues: 19:42 stacks لا يسمع، لا يبصر، ولا يغني; 19:58 answers recitation with an immediate إذا-triggered bodily response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nonperceiving objects and later responsive hearers; I infer a contrastive test of living receptivity. Alternatively, 19:42 may remain only a local polemic against idols.

changed_reading.before: Falling and weeping are exemplary devotional gestures.
changed_reading.after: Falling and weeping demonstrate that these recipients are alive to signs, the exact opposite of objects that cannot hear or see.

context_deltas.mechanism: Abraham joins follow me, I guide you, and a straight, sound path. The focus then joins divine guidance to recitation-as-following, so guidance becomes a relay: a guided person can guide another, and the body follows the signs.

activation_trace.role: Following and tracking supply the interpersonal link in the relay.
Gentle direction makes a guided person the local guide toward truth.
The straight road supplies the relay's traversable course.
Integrity and straightness qualify the course as sound and complete.
Divine direction identifies the focus recipients as prior links in that relay.
Following and succession let recitation continue the relay into bodily response.

structural_cues: The first-person sequence فاتبعني أهدك in 19:43 makes guidance move through a human invitation before 19:58 generalizes those guided.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies follow, guide, path, and later recitation followed by falling; I infer a transmission relay joining these motions. Alternatively, Abraham's invitation may illustrate guidance without defining the focus group's response.

changed_reading.before: Those in 19:58 are individual recipients of divine guidance.
changed_reading.after: They are relay points: guided people transmit a route, while recitation recruits later bodies into following that route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same Merciful name frames disobedience and feared punishment that could end in allegiance to the rebel. Tears before the Merciful's signs can therefore hold relational danger and rescue, not softness alone.

activation_trace.role: Tender mercy is the very relation against which disobedience is defined.
Departure from obedience supplies the threatened relational breach.
Painful punishment supplies the feared consequence within the mercy frame.
Affiliation and support supply the alternative bond Abraham fears.
The signs remain signs of tender mercy despite the preceding warning.
Tears can carry fear of breached allegiance together with tenderness.

structural_cues: Al-Rahman appears in 19:44-45 inside warning language and returns in 19:58 as the owner of the recited signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, disobedience, punishment, rival allegiance, and tears; I infer that the tears can register danger within mercy. Joy, gratitude, or grief remain materially live alternatives.

changed_reading.before: The tears are mainly a soft response to merciful signs.
changed_reading.after: The tears can be mercy-shaped alarm: recognition that disobedience risks transfer into a rival allegiance, while the signs reopen refuge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Abraham's separation is followed by gifted descendants; mercy then gives public truth, and Moses receives a brother as a prophet. Kinship in the focus is not merely inherited biology: divine gift can preserve, enlarge, and reconstitute the relational line.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal to a side supplies the severance from the inherited worship network.
A gift without exchange supplies descendants after that severance.
Merciful tenderness names the source of the added relational goods.
Brotherhood supplies a lateral kinship gift alongside vertical descent.
Dispersed descendants anchor the changed model in the focus genealogy.
Gathering supplies divine recomposition of the selected relational field.

structural_cues: The فلما sequence in 19:49 places the gifts after Abraham's withdrawal; 19:53 repeats gift language for a brother.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severance followed by descendants and a separately gifted brother; I infer relational reconstitution. Alternatively, the gifts reward fidelity without replacing what separation cost.

changed_reading.before: The descendant clauses honor an already established sacred pedigree.
changed_reading.after: The sacred line is repeatedly remade by gift after rupture, extending vertically through descendants and laterally through a brother.

context_deltas.mechanism: Promise-keeping leads into commanding one's household to prayer and purification. Descent therefore transmits favor only as enacted fidelity: the family becomes a practice-bearing circuit whose prostration is cultivated, not a passive title.

activation_trace.role: A promise that opens expectation supplies durable interpersonal fidelity.
The near group of belonging supplies the household transmission unit.
Specified worship supplies the repeated household discipline.
Purity and soundness supply the discipline's social and material counterpart.
The descendant field anchors household practice in transgenerational spread.
Submission supplies the embodied practice that the household relay yields.

structural_cues: 19:54-55 moves from a prophet's truthful promise to sustained command of his household, immediately before the focus genealogy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fidelity, household command, prayer, purification, and later descendants in prostration; I infer a transmission mechanism through practice. Alternatively, these may be parallel virtues rather than a causal circuit.

changed_reading.before: Descendants inherit inclusion among the favored.
changed_reading.after: Favor travels through households as kept commitments and repeated worship, producing descendants capable of embodied response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context raises Idris to a high place, then the focus immediately makes the favored fall and lower themselves. Vertical honor is verified by downward responsiveness rather than by remaining socially or bodily above.

activation_trace.role: Physical raising supplies the upward vector immediately before the focus.
Height completes the elevated endpoint from which the sequence turns.
The sounding fall reverses the preceding upward vector.
Deliberate lowering turns reversal into submission rather than loss of rank.

structural_cues: 19:57 and 19:58 are adjacent and juxtapose رفع/علي with خروا/سجدا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immediate up-then-down sequence; I infer that descent interprets rather than cancels elevation. Alternatively, the two verses may simply close one portrait and open a collective summary.

changed_reading.before: Elevation and prostration are separate honors in adjacent descriptions.
changed_reading.after: True elevation is tested by the capacity to descend: high place culminates in low posture before the signs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the bending branch is peripheral to the ordinary sense of اجتبينا. It remains anchored in the exact ج ب ي root and the immediate fall/prostration sequence; downstream prose should present it only as a branch-activated spatial echo, not as a lexical gloss.

activation_trace.role: Bending and gathering make selection spatially echo a collected, lowered posture.
The actual fall gives the branch-distant bending image a visible anchor.
Bowing the head and bending complete the shared downward geometry.

changed_reading.before: Selection precedes an independently chosen act of prostration.
changed_reading.after: Selection can be imaged as gathering people into the bent posture by which their chosenness becomes visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ت ل ل mapping rather than the ordinary recitation branch. It remains anchored by تتلى and خروا in the same conditional event; downstream prose should qualify it as possible toppling imagery, never as morphology or translation.

activation_trace.role: The alternate mapped image of casting down gives recitation a toppling force.
The explicit sounding fall visibly receives that exploratory force.

changed_reading.before: Recitation conveys content to which listeners subsequently react.
changed_reading.after: The recited signs can be imaged as exerting the force that topples the listeners into response.

strongest_changes: Favor and genealogy became a preservation-and-transmission system rather than a static honor roll.
Failed hearing and sight in 19:42 made the focus response evidence of living receptivity, while 19:43 made guidance an interpersonal relay.
The immediate rise in 19:57 and fall in 19:58 recoded elevation as a rank verified by willing descent.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots themselves couple dispersal, carriage, gathering, kinship, and womb with a sound-and-body cascade; the context adds severance followed by gifted kinship, household transmission, warning within mercy, and a sharp vertical reversal.
remaining_uncertainties: The sequence supports but does not prove that Abraham's separation causally enables the gifted kinship that follows.
The tears may hold tenderness, warning, gratitude, grief, or several of these at once.
The bending ج ب ي and toppling ت ل ل activations are deliberately branch-distant and must remain exploratory.
